BOX step 3 — extent: Delaware WCA (v1, generated)

Grain: one lateral per api10; gate-1 final set wells_final_WCA.csv. Evidence = first prod ≥ 2016 (n = 11,146); pre-2016 n = 1,160 (negative evidence only). Extent = drilled core (step-2 outline eroded by r = ½ mi back onto the laterals, D21) + per-segment buffer: k = 0.75, cap = 7,920 ft, floor 880 / 1,320 / 1,760 ft (pinned rolled / unknown / strong), perf reference = pool interior median (22,238 bbl / 1,000 ft, 12-mo calendar oil as Novi computed it, D9 cohort, median).
